_note: Full anchor AXIAL stack (Zone 1 anode → Zone 2 PEEK sleeve → Zone 3 flange → Zone 4 radome, 01_01 §1+§3). Second integration artifact after the capsule-end Assembly: MEASURES the PRESS-FIT interfaces Zone-1↔Zone-2 and Zone-2↔Zone-3 that no prior part proved mate. An AUDIT table, not a part pass/fail. Findings at frozen defaults: F1 sleeve_zone3 = −1.0 mm = 1 mm CLEARANCE per side (Zone-3 shank Ø9 placeholder ≪ bore Ø11 → NOT press-fit) → HW.8 shank-Ø reconcile; F2 insertion budget = 50−18−14 = 18 mm of PEEK gap (the Zone-1 lock's WHOLE shank inserts, ⚖️ founder 2026-10-12, 00_07 HW.26 G1 branch (А); what holds that depth is open - the step is zero on a Ø11 anode, HW.26; 6 mm on the retired placeholder 30); overall stack length 93 mm (anode bottom → flange top; the anode = gyroid body 40 + lock shank 18); embedded depth 90 mm (to the flange UNDERSIDE = the bark line, ⚖️ HW.33 2026-09-18) + radome over bark — sleeve 50 + the whole gyroid 40 in the wood (60 · 63 before G1, when the placeholder put 30 mm of the 40 mm envelope inside the bore). Nested Zone1/Zone2/Capsule inherit the frozen dims; render uses the Zone-1 envelope (solid Ø11, press-fit cares about OD). Axial mirror of the capsule-side Z-stack tools/in_silico/scripts/52_z_stack_tolerance.py. zone1_lock_manifest NAMES the lock whose shank IS the Zone-1 shank (its numbers stay in that file; its DIN-471 groove bounds nothing since 2026-09-18 - no ring is fitted, 00_07 HW.26): the stack takes the shank length from it at load (AxialStack.Load) and inserts it whole (G1, 2026-10-12) - there is no insertion number in this manifest, and a stack naming no lock is refused. Bus liner = a bought PEEK tube (ID = wire - 11.41 um, OD = ID + 0.30, fitted hot at assembly step 4a, 01_01 1.4 / 3), ratified 2026-09-18; this stack carries its wall and protrusion only. Channel axis <-> bus root axis coaxiality is a REQUIRED callout of this stack, still NOT SPECIFIED: the insertion depth it waited on is decided (00_07 HW.26 G1, 2026-10-12), so the number is now HW.34's alone (ratified as a form 2026-09-18); this record has no tolerance slot, so the requirement lives here.
